statement: The complexified norm has a rank-four paired period/CM value set in a fixed field under norm algebraicity. Its cancelling algebraic first-direction jet has a transcendental second jet, and the displayed derivative-free several-variable criterion fails its exact numerical inequality.
depends_on: C.7.1; C.7.6; C.7.7; C.7.9; C.7.10; Waldschmidt1975Theorem1; Waldschmidt2009Theorems3.6-3.7
notes: Exact fixed-field squaring and automorphy proved. On E361 at Q the second jet ratio is 4*pi/A-8. The main norm algebraicity question remains undecided.
